problems.problem: Day 5 is a hole in the batch ("holes": [5]) although status.js shows tao-01-d005-p alive (verdict VERIFIED, refutation not refuted). Only its revision was refuted (revrefute: rendering 任自然 as heaven and earth ‘following what is so of itself’ makes them the followers, where Wang Bi says they leave things to what is so of itself). The batch therefore breaks one entry per day, and the landed day 5 sentence it would leave in place fails the current gate (57 words; its plain sense repeats the key, “wish to be benevolent”).
problems.fix: Restore day 5 between days 4 and 6 with the key, ref (Tao Te Ching 5), at [4], by wang-bi and src of the revision, and the revrefute’s corrected sentence: “The chapter opens here, then says the same of the sages; Wang Bi, on chapter 5, reads it as heaven and earth making nothing and leaving all things to order themselves: earth grows no grass for beasts, yet beasts eat grass.” It is grounded in 天地任自然，無為無造，萬物自相治理 and 地不為獸生芻，而獸食芻; verse.js ok and entry-check ok (tested in scratch/critic1/5.json). Remove 5 from holes.

problems.problem: The plain sense is a dangling participle with no main clause: “Closing a chapter that likens the highest excellence to water;” runs straight into the semicolon, so grammatically the Heshang Gong commentary is what closes the chapter. A reader meets an unfinished half-sentence.
problems.fix: Give the clause a subject and verb, keeping the reading unchanged (it matches the comments on 夫唯不爭 壅之則止，決之則流，聽從人也 and on 故無尤 天下無有怨尤水者): “The verse closes a chapter that likens the highest excellence to water; the Heshang Gong commentary, on chapter 8, takes the not wrangling as water’s way of going along with people, stopping when dammed and flowing when released, so no one under heaven blames it.” entry-check ok (scratch/critic1/8fix.json).
